terms.participation.required: The selected member must be present and cannot be excluded by collection policy. Invocation failure is governed solely by failurePolicy.
terms.participation.optional: An identified profile policy may exclude the member before activation.
terms.failurePolicy.abort-tick: A failed invocation discards every uncommitted buffer in the tick.
terms.failurePolicy.drop-task: A failed optional invocation may be attributed and omitted without committing its buffer.
terms.affinity.main-thread: The host invokes the task on the runtime generation's main execution lane.
terms.affinity.any-worker: The scheduler may invoke the task on any declared worker lane.
terms.snapshots: The complete immutable capabilities made available to the worker for one tick.
terms.outputs: Vocabulary-owned channels, stages, and composition laws to which the worker may emit.

relationships: participation and failurePolicy are independent fields
output vocabulary stewards, rather than producers or schedulers, own composition semantics
